metadata.title: RAG Human Annotation Analysis Framework
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: RAG human annotation evaluation framework. Evaluates generated RAG responses against retrieved course evidence on factual correctness, evidence support, citation accuracy, pedagogical usefulness, clarity, language naturalness, and code-mixed comprehension. Without real human annotations, status remains strictly HUMAN_DATA_REQUIRED. Zero human ratings or inter-rater kappa values are fabricated.
metadata.ethical_notice: Requires institutional ethical approval / IRB clearance and informed consent prior to human data collection.
